qb.notes: Preseason = walk-forward Week 1 median × expected games (prior-year games played or 17; rookies capped). QB/RB/WR blend with prior-year PPG when α<1. Draft cohort = depth-filtered preseason roster (no Sleeper overlay). FantasyPros benchmark = week-1 consensus PPR × 17 (proxy); requires ≥30% FP coverage per season. ROS = YTD + rolling P50 × games remaining (4-week window). Players with fewer than 8 games played are excluded.
